Could you grow your own food on the moon? Neil deGrasse Tyson and co-hosts Chuck Nice and Gary O’Reilly sit down with Kevin Espiritu, the gardening YouTuber behind Epic Gardening, to dig into backyard farming, the future of sustainable food, and what it would actually take to feed yourself on Earth or anywhere else.

Kevin describes how he got into growing plants and how it doesn’t always require lots of land. Chuck admits to being an avid gardener secretly and fangirls over Kevin’s 30 fruit trees. How self-sufficient can you reasonably be on an urban lot? Do solar and rainwater collection save money? 

We get into the science of how plants actually grow. What's the difference between hydroponics and aeroponics? Why do hydroponic plants grow faster but taste flatter? Do plants use green light?
